name: TOB Sunday School Verse Completion
description: A student's claim to have recited/memorized a TOB Sunday School Memory Verse. Created as Pending when the student taps "I recited it" (api/sunday_school.py::mark_memory_verse_complete) — a student can NEVER set status to Verified themselves; only a teacher/admin can, via api/sunday_school_admin.py::verify_verse_completion, which also assigns rank and awards points through the engine. This is what keeps the whole memorization system honest for a kids' context.

fields.label: Rank
fields.description: 1st/2nd/3rd place among this verse's Verified completions — set by the teacher on verification, drives the 15/10/5 point award (TOB Sunday School Settings).
